title: Run detail keeps its viewing position across live reads and reload
description: Read only against an existing run. Select an owned Agent Chrome tab and set FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT, FARMSLOT_RUN_LAYOUT_TAB, FARMSLOT_RUN_LAYOUT_RUN and FARMSLOT_RUN_LAYOUT_OUTPUT. Use TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json. Brings the page to the foreground and scrolls the timeline into view before recording. Captures arrivals and a real reload, including the new document. Checks visible viewport anchors, component identity and transient notice presence after frame updates; retains raw off-screen geometry separately because live history may grow. Takes no run or slot action and injects no application data.

stable-run-detail.intent: Record an existing live run, preserve a nonzero viewing position through reload, and prove visible layout and notices stay stable.
